english.title: Cause use of a pedal cycle without lights being fitted
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a pedal cycle which was not fitted with **(..SPECIFY FRONT/REAR POSITION LAMP(S), REAR RETRO REFLECTOR and / or PEDAL RETRO REFLECTOR(S)..).
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 18(1) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989 and section 91 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused use on a road of a pedal cycle not fitted with
front/rear position lamp(s)/rear retro reflector/pedal retro reflector(s)

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 4(3) states that lamps need not be fitted between sunrise and sunset.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H3369 and H3386.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use a pedal cycle on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when it was not fitted with **(..SPECIFY FRONT/REAR POSITION LAMP(S), REAR RETRO REFLECTOR and / or PEDAL RETRO REFLECTOR(S)..).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
